'''2014 MPC Holotable Brian Fred LS We'll Handle This (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Brian Fred]] at [[2014 Match Play Championship]] (Holotable).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|We'll Handle This (V) / Duel Of The Fates (V)|VB5-L-wellhandlethis-pre.gif|label=We'll Handle This / Duel Of The Fates (V)}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Holotable
